accepted_behavior: Query one complete current_source.address_points row by source identity
Resolve the referenced address through exactly one reviewed address identity crosswalk
Resolve source_record and exactly one evidence object from the derived source key
Construct a typed PostGIS point without source-precision truncation
Create one proposed_geometry_observation and one owned conditional authority exception
Create no canonical geometry version, quality approval, CRS transformation or per-field geometry assertions
Compare all source-attributable target rows through a separate read-only connection
Fail on missing or unexpected rows in either direction
Produce zero inserts and zero updates on the second execution
Prove failing mutations roll back in the same database before reset
recorded_conditions: Acceptance is bound to the exact implementation commit, transform-spec row and reviewer-oracle hashes above; changing any of them invalidates pattern acceptance until SDA review
The process-level oracle gate is accepted for this deterministic single-thread design harness, but it is not an identity or security boundary
Observed-output code must remain free of acceptance-oracle reads; acceptance oracles remain comparator/test authority only
The address identity crosswalk is a prerequisite owned by the identity/crosswalk transform, not an output owned by the geometry transform
Every replicated transform group requires its own reviewer-owned expected-result oracle before implementation
Every replicated group requires an explicit callable and binding; the generic all-groups transform is not accepted as evidence
This contract accepts a transformation pattern only and does not close F02, F14, Phase A, NLI-WO-002 or NLI-WO-002B
replication_rule: No additional transform group may be implemented until the SDA publishes a group-specific reviewer oracle or explicitly authorizes a bounded batch containing such oracles.
